name: Blooded Yautja
description: (Tag:anti-alien)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:stealth)A jungle hunter of a species that lives for the hunt, blooded against the deadliest game its worlds can offer, other aliens included. Cloaking field, thermal vision, plasma caster, wristblades, and a code that only respects prey that can fight back. It will not hunt what it judges helpless.
